programme.desc: Curse of the Living Dead Chasing down clues about the true nature of demons, who were seen as controlling shape-shifters that could overtake human bodies; looking at grisly anti-demon tools used by our ancestors.
programme.title: Mythical Beasts

programme.desc: S02 E04 — Horror Hotel U.S. Navy veteran turned private investigator Jennifer Marshall and journalist Ozzy Mora investigate chilling claims and a mysterious death at the infamous Cecil Hotel in Los Angeles.
programme.title: Mysteries Decoded

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Chaz Higgs Kathy Augustine was a politician serving in the Nevada Senate; shortly after her husband of 17 years dies from complications of a stroke, she marries Chaz Higgs, a critical care nurse whom she met while he was caring for her late husband.
programme.title: Murder by Medic

programme.desc: S01 E03 Digging into a UFO crash caught on camera in Brazil; a close encounter of the Beatles kind; finding out if aliens shut down a nuclear missile launch site in Montana; looking at the shapes of UFOs and considering a link between ghosts and aliens.
programme.title: Evidence of the Unexplained

programme.desc: S03 E02 — Hawaiian UFOs and More UFOs hover over government property in Hawaii; the spirit of a little boy in a haunted cave; a crucifix moves on its own.
programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: S04 E06 — Archaeological Mysteries Puzzle over an out-of-place relic from World War II and get a bird's-eye view of stone circles in Norway; examine mysterious, ancient mounds on the banks of the Mississippi and uncover the dark history of a medieval English village.
programme.title: Mysteries From Above

programme.desc: S04 E01 — No Place Like Home A couple moves into a new home, only to find that a previous owner hasn't moved out; a woman's stepmother refuses to rest in peace; a haunted house is built on the site of a terrible tragedy.
programme.title: Paranormal Survivor

programme.desc: S04 E02 — Spirits That Harm A jealous entity leaves a painful mark on a man; a homeowner is left bruised and burned when she gets caught in the crossfire between two territorial spirits; a pair of ghosts are outraged at a couple's lifestyle.
programme.title: Paranormal Survivor

programme.desc: S04 E03 — Taken Over by Spirits A couple unleashes something terrifying while renovating a classic car; a pair of murderous spirits possess a family in Pennsylvania; something demonic takes over a teenage boy, forcing his parents to take drastic action.
programme.title: Paranormal Survivor

programme.desc: S04 E04 — Uninvited Evil A woman's young nephew is attacked by something horrific; a man takes a job at a restaurant with a resident ghost; a woman is stalked by an obsessive spirit with a violent streak.
programme.title: Paranormal Survivor

programme.desc: S04 E05 — Animal Nightmares A family is terrorized by a supernatural beast that stalks around their trailer.
programme.title: Paranormal Survivor

programme.desc: S04 E06 — Horrifying History The ghosts of prisoners make jailhouse ghost tours too scary; a woman is attacked by a spirit lurking in her historic home; renovations unleash ghosts protecting a centuries-old secret.
programme.title: Paranormal Survivor

programme.desc: S03 E01 — Paul Burrell Explores why Diana's former butler, Paul Burrell, thinks that strange smoke and noises in his home can be a sign that the People's Princess is reaching out from beyond the grave; The team's investigation opens the door for two lost souls to reunite.
programme.title: Celebrity Help! My House Is Haunted

programme.desc: S03 E02 — Tina Malone Tackling the skeletal figure that has been chasing an English actor for as long as she can remember; a regression therapist takes Tina Malone back to her childhood; unmasking the devil's debt collectors hunting for an indebted soul.
programme.title: Celebrity Help! My House Is Haunted

programme.desc: Buried Secrets Legend says Ashmore Estates is shrouded in shadows and mystery. But as the team investigates, they uncover a haunting with a purpose; one that runs deeper than ghost stories and reveals a reason that changes everything.
programme.title: Paranormal Mysteries

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Strathroy Paranormal Looping Exploring Strathroy, an Ontario community with a dark past plagued by fires, train wrecks and serial killers; confronting the paranormal energy that engulfs the town and makes its residents the uneasy neighbours of poltergeists and phantoms.
programme.title: My Haunted Hometown

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Bellaire Paranormal Ley Lines Stepping into the crosshairs in Bellaire, a village that sits on a focal point for paranormal energy; exploring the bloody history of warfare, mining disasters and mass casualties that make this town a haunted hot spot.
programme.title: My Haunted Hometown

programme.desc: S02 E01 — Hollymount Farm Liam describes the overbearing ghost boy that terrified him for years in his family's farmhouse; investigate this strange apparition with Danny, who uncovers generations' worth of hushed-up sightings by Liam's family and friends.
programme.title: Uncanny

programme.desc: S02 E02 — The Charity Shop Poltergeist Facing a destructive spirit that has been menacing charity shop manager Sybil and her co-workers; dig in with Danny, who discovers a hidden room, clues about this entity's identity and possible links to something called the "stone tape theory."
programme.title: Uncanny

programme.desc: S02 E03 — Shadow Man Meet Julian, who tells Danny about the towering shadow figure that has been terrorizing him; delve into one of the scariest cases Danny has investigated and find out if this apparition is supernatural or something more sinister.
programme.title: Uncanny

programme.desc: Danny Robins investigates the real-life stories of seemingly paranormal encounters; in the process, he talks to people who say they have encountered the supernatural and consults experts in order to discover the truth.
programme.title: Uncanny

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Pennhurst State School and Hospital Walk the halls of this home for the differently abled, where overcrowding, lack of funding and understaffing lead to neglect and rampant abuse.
programme.title: Paranormal Evidence: You Can't Deny it
